items.title: Plushies (Merchandise)
items.summary: The Plushies are plush toys based on the Five Nights at Freddy's characters that represent characters from the games, novels, and films.  They are mainly made by Sanshee, Funko, GoodStuff, Hex, Youtooz, and Jazwares.

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's (Mobile)
items.summary: The mobile port for Five Nights at Freddy's was first released for Android on August 25, 2014 and iOS on September 11, 2014.  Both ports cost $2.
